verdict.rationale: Raygun documents its own controls over what data it stores: a 'Disable IP address storage' application setting and filtering of sensitive fields before errors are sent. This gives some control over retained data, but nothing in the pack covers configurable retention periods or deleting stored error data. missing for 10: configurable retention windows, documented deletion/purge of stored error or user data (e.g., per-user erasure requests), API-driven retention/deletion controls, independent corroboration.
